trajectory: There have been two product fix rounds. The r6->r7 round (0bb67da) added one statement, `times.sort` before thinning in clip.py's _fill_interval_gaps, and two test parameters. The r7->r8 round (ef0a094 via 35018de) touches different functions. In loft_media._embed_frames it adds one deadline adjustment, which extends the existing budget by the time spent paused. It adds no new branch or state, only a local timestamp. In indexer.prioritize it removes the `and not wants_candidates` condition and turns the if/else into two independent conditions, so the FRAME_OCR rebuild is queued again exactly when it was before this change, and the fetch is queued alongside it. Neither round repeats a branch, state or prediction that the other added. The second round removes a condition the original change had introduced, rather than layering a new one. There is no sign that the design is being patched.
